channel.title: Sheera Shamsu
channel.description: Notes on verifying a garbage collector in F* and Pulse.

item.title: OCaml Closures, Simply Explained
item.description: How OCaml lays out a closure in memory, native and bytecode, and which words the GC must scan. Four small examples, one diagram each.

item.title: The Part You Cannot Hand Off
item.description: I wrote four properties in English and handed the F* to an assistant. Three of the specifications that came back were false, all in the same way.

item.title: What the Specifications Did Not Say
item.description: Auditing the specifications of a verified OCaml garbage collector. Three findings, all of them gaps between what the proofs cover and the heaps OCaml actually produces.
